name: Collateral Valuation 13
definition: Valuation details of each piece of collateral posted.

CollateralDirection.name: Collateral Direction
CollateralDirection.definition: Direction of the collateral being reported.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Settlement status of the instruction/financial instrument movement.

AppliedExcessIndicator.name: Applied Excess Indicator
AppliedExcessIndicator.definition: Indicates if the collateral being reported is applied or in excess.

NumberOfDaysAccrued.name: Number Of Days Accrued
NumberOfDaysAccrued.definition: Number of days used for interest calculation.

DayCountBasis.name: Day Count Basis
DayCountBasis.definition: Computation method of (accrued) interest of the security.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Exchange rate between the currency of the collateral and the reporting currency.

CurrencyHaircut.name: Currency Haircut
CurrencyHaircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the currency of the collateral expressed as a percentage.

AdjustedRate.name: Adjusted Rate
AdjustedRate.definition: Percentage by which the collateral amount needs to be adjusted.

SecuritiesCollateral.name: Securities Collateral
SecuritiesCollateral.definition: Provides details on the securities collateral.

CashCollateral.name: Cash Collateral
CashCollateral.definition: Details of the cash collateral valuation.
